description: This file is an example script demonstrating the use of Timer and op fuzzers to benchmark kernel performance in PyTorch, including functions for comparing dictionaries, running benchmarks with different fuzzers, and outputting timing results.

methods.name: assert_dicts_equal
methods.description: Compares two dictionaries for equality, with special handling for numpy arrays to avoid ValueError.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs benchmark tests using specified fuzzers and measures execution times, then outputs formatted results.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that executes multiple benchmark runs with different statements and fuzzers.
